title: informational validity of Mirror stitching views
hypothesis: A connector can match a task output across representations while those representations differ in retained information; per-view counterfactual tasks and linear information probes will detect the mismatch, including for shared-basis Mirror stitching.

mirror_insertion.physical_object: one rank-2 linear hidden-state connector basis
mirror_insertion.coordinate: task-addressed rank-2 Givens rotation between shared connector A and B maps
mirror_insertion.logical_functions: task-specific scalar predictions from the same representation

task.type: synthetic representation stitching and information audit
task.input: eight-dimensional hidden representation, sampled from three fixed encoders over latent scalar features u and v

representations.full: contains both u and v plus independent nuisance features
representations.task0_only: preserves u and replaces v with independent structured nuisance
representations.unrelated_noise: all coordinates independent of u and v

task.targets: task 0 predicts u; task 1 predicts v; task 2 is an independent random negative-control target
task.data_generator: fixed split-specific seeds; audit generator remains unopened unless all preregistered validation criteria pass

training.task_schedule: uniform per example among task0 and task1; task2 is evaluation-only

decision_rules.informational_validity_pass: Across all three fresh seeds, task0-only representation matches task0 output within 0.05 MSE of the full representation while its task1 MSE is at least 0.5 worse; the u/v linear probes must independently show that task1 information is absent. This validates the diagnostic, not Mirror compression.
decision_rules.mirror_function_gate: On full representations, Mirror must be within 1.10x independent connector MSE on both tasks, use <=0.8x independent connector payload, and beat byte-matched FiLM by >=2% pooled MSE in all three fresh seeds.
decision_rules.failure: Mirror misses at least one of the quality/storage/Mirror-specific gates in two or more fresh seeds; output match alone never counts as informational equivalence.
decision_rules.audit: Do not generate audit examples unless all Mirror function gates pass in every fresh seed.

boundaries: full representation is intentionally shared-information and low-rank aligned
task0-only and unrelated-noise encoders deliberately remove information
no pretrained model, natural language, or general stitching claim
fixed update result is not capacity evidence
